Upon payment of full sale consideration by the buyer as agreed under this
agreement in the manner agreed above, within time and upon receipt thereof by
Seller and the Seller shall got NOC for vacation of charge over the subject
·property.

5. Once the Seller has received the Sale Price in accordance with this Agreement

and any costs or other amounts payable under this Agreement (the "Dues"), the
Seller and the Buyer will enter into a registered sale deed and the Seller shall
grant, convey and assign all its interests and rights in the Property by way of
absolute sale on to the Purchaser.
6. All expenditure and duties and taxes and charges relating to the registration of
the Sale Deed, etc. and transfer of title of the Property shall be borne by the
Purchaser including stamp duty, registration fee and any taxes.
